rules.rationale: This is the empty-case execution rule for observing the proof-domain list representation through MPY's iterator protocol; it produces #iterDone and does not assert an additional mathematical fact.
This is the ordinary iterator-step behavior for an integer-headed proof-domain list, yielding the head and the represented tail as part of the verification model.
This is the ordinary iterator-step behavior for a float-headed proof-domain list, yielding the head and the represented tail as part of the verification model.
This equation defines the named summary oddSquare as the square of a positive odd integer and zero otherwise.
This is the base equation defining doubleDifferenceSpec on the empty numeric sequence.
This is the integer-head recurrence defining doubleDifferenceSpec by adding the head's oddSquare contribution to the tail summary.
This is the float-head recurrence defining doubleDifferenceSpec to ignore the non-integer head and continue with the tail.
This base equation defines finalNumber for an empty remaining sequence as the prior loop-target value.
This recurrence defines finalNumber for an integer head by carrying that head forward while processing the tail.
This recurrence defines finalNumber for a float head by carrying that head forward while processing the tail.
